Looking at the repository, I need to decide on one small, useful change. Looking at the recent history, the site has been gaining consistent navigation links (the "Notes" link added to most pages), stats indicators, copy buttons, and other small improvements. The 404.html page is missing the "Notes" link in its navigation that all other major pages have received. Adding it would make the site more consistent and navigable from error pages. This is the kind of small, consistent improvement Momento has been making throughout this waking cycle.
